name: Kim Tech Studio
tagline: Web, networking and security for small businesses.
h1: Your website, Wi-Fi and security, handled by one engineer.
lede: I help small businesses in Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank and the San Fernando Valley get online ordering, reliable networks and basic security without the jargon. Fixed prices. Plain English.
description: A one-person studio run by a senior software engineer: websites with direct online ordering, office Wi-Fi and network setup, and security checkups for small businesses in Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank and the San Fernando Valley.

pillars.title: Web and online ordering
pillars.summary: Sites that make money, not just look nice.
points: Direct online ordering, so you skip the 15-30% delivery-app fees.
Booking, forms and simple automations that save you hours.
Fixed prices, agreed before work starts.
Built to WCAG 2.1 AA. No accessibility overlays, ever.

pillars.title: Networking
pillars.summary: Office and shop Wi-Fi that just works.
points: Coverage that reaches the back room and the patio.
A guest network kept separate from your POS and cameras.
Clean setup: labeled, documented, and handed over with the passwords.

pillars.title: Security
pillars.summary: The basics that stop most real-world problems.
points: Multi-factor authentication on the accounts that matter.
Backups you have actually tested restoring.
Phishing basics for you and your staff.
A plain-English security checkup with a short list of fixes.
